text: TEN Ltd is Tsakos Energy Navigation Limited, an energy shipping company incorporated in Bermuda and listed on the New York Stock Exchange. Its 2026 AGM proxy statement reports, as of 30 March 2026: Tsakos Holdings Foundation 10.7% of common shares, its subsidiaries First Tsakos Investments 8.2% and Redmont Trading 2.4%, and entities affiliated with founder CEO Nikolas Tsakos: Sea Consolidation 1,550,000 shares, Intermed Champion 893,500, Methoni Shipping 1,448,702, Tsakos Energy Management 1,075,000, Panayotis Tsakos 2,317,202 and Nikolas Tsakos 5,023,802.
short: TEN Ltd = NYSE-listed Tsakos Energy Navigation; Tsakos Holdings Foundation and Tsakos family entities are the biggest disclosed holders.
